metadata.neutral_citation: HUI DIN FUN v. TONG CHUNG HOI [2001] HKCFI 557
metadata.case_name: HUI DIN FUN v. TONG CHUNG HOI

plaintiff.occupation_before: Manual labourer in the refurbishing/decoration industry; previously worked as a security guard and manual labourer in factories
plaintiff.occupation_after: No employment since the day of the accident
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Sedentary or simple work (e.g. cashier, lift operator, janitor, office assistant, messenger)
plaintiff.education_level: Secondary school education in the mainland

injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: complication of wound infection and cross-union of radius and ulna.
source: During the course of his treatment the Plaintiff had complication of wound infection and cross-union of radius and ulna.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shafts of both ulna and radius

source: During the course of his treatment the Plaintiff had complication of wound infection and cross-union of radius and ulna.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

manifestations.description: Post-traumatic amnesia (regained continuous memory some 10 days later)
Mild cognitive impairment in memory and intelligence
Mild mood impairment showing signs of frustration, despair, irritability and insomnia
Visual impairment of the left eye: visual acuity in the left eye remains poor and diplopia when the Plaintiff looked to the left

Decreased motor power in the left handgrip and pinch power of left thumb; decrease in sensation on the radial side of the left hand; loss of sensation in all of the appendages of the left hand; limitation of movement of the left thumb; loss in left elbow extension, pronation and left wrist flexion
Loss in flexion, extension, supination in the right elbow; limitation in right wrist movements

treatments_received: Transferred to Kowloon Hospital for rehabilitation
Multiple operations including treatment of fractures, operation to relieve nerve compression and tendon transfer

losses.description: Decreased motor power and loss of sensation of the left and right upper limbs, limitation of movement of the left thumb, loss in left elbow extension, pronation and left wrist flexion, and limitation in right wrist and elbow movements.
Visual impairment of the left eye with poor visual acuity and diplopia.
Mild cognitive impairment affecting memory and intelligence and some power to concentrate.
Mild mood impairment showing signs of frustration, despair, irritability and insomnia.
